items.title: Workshop Report: add a per-row Fetch-from-Nexus action (fixes Merge Plugins missing never-fetched Workshop collections)
items.why: Director's tester's real complaint: a Workshop collection she authored but never fetched doesn't show up in Merge Plugins at all. Confirmed via code read -- Merge Plugins' own picker just needs a local collection.json to list a collection, and the existing Rebuild Missing Files fetch mechanism already creates exactly that. Reuse it, don't rebuild it.
items.prompt:
Follow-up to the Workshop Report build (`workshop-report` queue item) -- do this AFTER that one lands, not concurrently, since it adds a row action to the same table.

REAL BUG THIS FIXES: a Workshop collection Vortex tracks but that's never been fetched (no local `collection.json`) is invisible to Merge Plugins -- confirmed via code read: `web/merge-routes.js`'s `/collections` and `/plugins` both call `syncRunner.listInstalledCollections(staging)` -> `lib/collection-runner.js`'s `scanStagingCollections(stagingDir)`, which only ever finds collections that already have a local `collection.json` on disk. Director's tester hit exactly this with a Workshop collection she'd authored but never fetched.

WHY THIS FIX WORKS (verified via code read, not guessed): Rebuild Missing Files' existing `POST /api/rebuild-missing/refresh-from-nexus` (see `refreshCollectionFromNexus` in `web/rebuild-missing-routes.js`) already handles a genuine first-time fetch -- `destDir = path.join(staging, collectionModId)`, so fetching writes a real `collection.json` into a real new folder under staging. Confirmed live in `ff37c49`'s own testing: right after a first fetch, the collection immediately appeared in Rebuild Missing Files' own picker with a real mod count. `scanStagingCollections` needs nothing more than that same `collection.json` presence to list a collection, so the SAME fetch action would make it visible to Merge Plugins too.

SCOPE: add a per-row "⬇ Fetch from Nexus" action to Workshop Report's table, for rows where `fetched: false` (the "not yet downloaded" ones already surfaced there per the base build). DO NOT reimplement the fetch mechanism -- call the EXISTING `POST /api/rebuild-missing/refresh-from-nexus` endpoint directly from Workshop Report's own client JS (cross-tool API call, no duplication; that route already knows how to do a first fetch vs. a refresh via its own `isFirstFetch` branch, and Workshop Report already has the `collectionModId`/`slug` it needs from its own row data). On success: update that row in place (drop the "Not downloaded yet" state, show a real revision/timestamp, swap in the Open Staging Folder action) rather than requiring a full page reload.

HONEST FOLLOW-UP NOTE FOR THE UI: fetching only gets `collection.json` (metadata) -- no actual mod files land in staging yet, so Merge Plugins' own plugin scan for that collection will still come up empty until the user actually rebuilds it. Say this plainly in the success state (something like "Fetched. Run Rebuild Missing Files or Rebuild Collection to pull the actual files before merging.") so nobody thinks one click alone finished the job -- run this copy through plain-language-writer, casual register (informational, not consequential -- the write itself is metadata-only and already has its own backup-before-overwrite handling upstream).

VERIFY live against a real never-fetched Workshop collection (the director's tester's own collection, or an equivalent one) -- confirm it's invisible to Merge Plugins BEFORE the fetch, confirm the fetch succeeds and the row updates in place, confirm it's now visible/pickable in Merge Plugins' own collection picker afterward (even with zero plugins found yet, matching the honest expectation above). Handoff with what you tested.
